prompt: Write a secure server-side currency system for my Roblox game: players earn Gold from defeating enemies and spend it in a shop. Give me the core modules (concise) and explain the key decisions.
final_text:
Here are four modules. Nothing was run or tested in Studio, so treat this as a starting point. Layout:

```
ServerScriptService/
  DataService.lua      (ModuleScript)
  Currency.lua         (ModuleScript)
  Shop.lua             (ModuleScript, also holds the catalog)
  Enemies.lua          (ModuleScript, payout on kill)
  Main.server.lua      (Script, wires it together)
```

## DataService.lua: persistence with session locking

```lua
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData_v1")
local LOCK_TIMEOUT, AUTOSAVE = 90, 60
local DEFAULT = { Gold = 0, Items = {} }

local DataService = {}
local sessions = {} -- [Player] = data table (live, server-only)

local function copy(t)
	local c = {}
	for k, v in t do c[k] = type(v) == "table" and copy(v) or v end
	return c
end

local function reconcile(data)
	for k, v in DEFAULT do
		if data[k] == nil then data[k] = type(v) == "table" and copy(v) or v end
	end
	return data
end

local function load(key)
	local data
	local ok = pcall(function()
		store:UpdateAsync(key, function(old)
			data = nil -- transform can retry
			old = old or { Data = copy(DEFAULT) }
			local lock = old.Lock
			if lock and lock.JobId ~= game.JobId and os.time() - lock.Time < LOCK_TIMEOUT then
				return nil -- another server owns this player: cancel
			end
			old.Lock = { JobId = game.JobId, Time = os.time() }
			data = old.Data
			return old
		end)
	end)
	return ok and data or nil
end

local function save(player, release)
	local data = sessions[player]
	if not data then return end
	pcall(function()
		store:UpdateAsync("P_" .. player.UserId, function(old)
			if not old or not old.Lock or old.Lock.JobId ~= game.JobId then
				return nil -- we lost the lock; never overwrite the new owner
			end
			old.Data = data
			old.Lock = (not release) and { JobId = game.JobId, Time = os.time() } or nil
			return old
		end)
	end)
end

function DataService.Get(player) return sessions[player] end

local function onJoin(player)
	local data
	for _ = 1, 5 do
		data = load("P_" .. player.UserId)
		if data then break end
		task.wait(3)
	end
	if not data then
		player:Kick("Could not load your data. Please rejoin.") -- fail closed
		return
	end
	if not player.Parent then return end
	sessions[player] = reconcile(data)
	DataService.Loaded:Fire(player)
end

DataService.Loaded = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
DataService.Loaded = { Fire = function(_, p) DataService._cb(p) end } -- replaced below
function DataService.OnLoaded(cb) DataService._cb = cb end

function DataService.Start()
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(p) task.spawn(onJoin, p) end)
	for _, p in Players:GetPlayers() do task.spawn(onJoin, p) end
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p)
		save(p, true)
		sessions[p] = nil
	end)
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(AUTOSAVE)
			for p in sessions do task.spawn(save, p, false) end
		end
	end)
	game:BindToClose(function()
		for p in sessions do task.spawn(save, p, true) end
		task.wait(5)
	end)
end

DataService.Save = save
return DataService
```

I left a clumsy `Loaded` stub in there. Replace those three `Loaded`/`_cb` lines with a plain callback:

```lua
local onLoadedCb
function DataService.OnLoaded(cb) onLoadedCb = cb end
-- and in onJoin: if onLoadedCb then onLoadedCb(player) end
```

## Currency.lua: the only code that touches Gold

```lua
local DataService = require(script.Parent.DataService)

local MAX_GOLD = 1_000_000_000
local MAX_SINGLE = 1_000_000

local Currency = {}

local function validAmount(n)
	return type(n) == "number" and n % 1 == 0 and n > 0 and n <= MAX_SINGLE -- rejects NaN/inf/floats/negatives
end

local function sync(player, data)
	player:SetAttribute("Gold", data.Gold) -- read-only mirror for UI; client writes never reach the server
end

function Currency.Get(player)
	local d = DataService.Get(player)
	return d and d.Gold or 0
end

function Currency.Add(player, amount, reason)
	local d = DataService.Get(player)
	if not d or not validAmount(amount) then return false end
	d.Gold = math.min(d.Gold + amount, MAX_GOLD)
	sync(player, d)
	print(("[Gold] +%d %s (%s)"):format(amount, player.Name, reason or "?"))
	return true
end

-- Check and deduct in one step, with no yield between them.
function Currency.TrySpend(player, amount, reason)
	local d = DataService.Get(player)
	if not d or not validAmount(amount) or d.Gold < amount then return false end
	d.Gold -= amount
	sync(player, d)
	print(("[Gold] -%d %s (%s)"):format(amount, player.Name, reason or "?"))
	return true
end

Currency.Sync = function(player)
	local d = DataService.Get(player)
	if d then sync(player, d) end
end

return Currency
```

## Shop.lua: server-owned prices, client sends only an item ID

```lua
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Currency = require(script.Parent.Currency)
local DataService = require(script.Parent.DataService)

local CATALOG = { -- prices live ONLY on the server
	IronSword = { Price = 100, Unique = true },
	HealthPotion = { Price = 25, Unique = false, MaxStack = 20 },
}

local remote = Instance.new("RemoteFunction")
remote.Name = "PurchaseItem"
remote.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local lastCall = {} -- [Player] = os.clock()

remote.OnServerInvoke = function(player, itemId)
	-- 1. rate limit
	local now = os.clock()
	if lastCall[player] and now - lastCall[player] < 0.5 then return "RateLimited" end
	lastCall[player] = now

	-- 2. validate untrusted input
	if type(itemId) ~= "string" then return "Invalid" end
	local item = CATALOG[itemId]
	local data = DataService.Get(player)
	if not item or not data then return "Invalid" end

	-- 3. business rules (all on server state)
	local owned = data.Items[itemId] or 0
	if item.Unique and owned > 0 then return "AlreadyOwned" end
	if item.MaxStack and owned >= item.MaxStack then return "StackFull" end

	-- 4. spend then grant, with no yields in between, so it can't be interleaved or duplicated
	if not Currency.TrySpend(player, item.Price, "shop:" .. itemId) then return "NotEnoughGold" end
	data.Items[itemId] = owned + 1
	return "OK"
end

game:GetService("Players").PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p) lastCall[p] = nil end)
return {}
```

## Enemies.lua: server decides kills and payouts

```lua
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Currency = require(script.Parent.Currency)

local REWARDS = { Goblin = 10, Orc = 35, Boss = 500 } -- keyed by server-side enemy type

local Enemies = {}

-- Call this from YOUR server-side damage code, never from a RemoteEvent argument.
function Enemies.RecordDamage(enemy, attacker)
	enemy:SetAttribute("LastAttacker", attacker.UserId)
end

function Enemies.Register(enemy) -- enemy Model with Humanoid, spawned by the server
	local hum = enemy:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local reward = REWARDS[enemy:GetAttribute("EnemyType")]
	if not hum or not reward then return end
	local paid = false
	hum.Died:Once(function()
		if paid then return end
		paid = true
		local killer = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(enemy:GetAttribute("LastAttacker") or 0)
		if killer then Currency.Add(killer, reward, "kill:" .. enemy.Name) end
	end)
end

return Enemies
```

## Main.server.lua

```lua
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataService = require(script.Parent.DataService)
local Currency = require(script.Parent.Currency)
require(script.Parent.Shop)

DataService.OnLoaded(Currency.Sync)
DataService.Start()
```

Client UI reads `player:GetAttribute("Gold")` and `GetAttributeChangedSignal("Gold")`. It calls `PurchaseItem:InvokeServer("IronSword")` and shows the result string.

## Key decisions

1. **The client never sends an amount, price, or "I killed it".** The shop remote takes only an item ID string, and everything else (price, ownership, balance) is looked up server-side. Kill rewards come from the server's own `Died` event and a server-side reward table. Exploiters can fire remotes with any arguments, so the only safe remotes are ones with nothing valuable to lie about.
2. **One module controls Gold.** `Currency` is the only code that mutates the balance, and it validates every amount. The `n % 1 == 0` check rejects floats, NaN, and infinity, and the other checks reject negatives and huge values. There's also a hard cap on balance and per-transaction size. Add, spend, and logging all go through one place, so auditing is easy.
3. **Atomic purchases without locks.** Luau is cooperatively scheduled, so there is no race as long as nothing yields between the balance check and the deduction. `TrySpend` and the item grant are one yield-free block. This closes the classic dupe where a player fires two purchase requests during a yield. The 0.5s debounce is only spam protection.
4. **Session locking in the DataStore.** Each save writes `{JobId, Time}` as a lock via `UpdateAsync`. A second server (for example, a fast rejoin or teleport) can't load the profile while the first holds a fresh lock, and a server that has lost its lock won't overwrite the newer data. This blocks gold duplication across servers. `UpdateAsync` is used instead of `SetAsync` because it is read-modify-write.
5. **Fail closed.** If data can't load after retries, the player is kicked rather than given default data. Otherwise an outage would let them play on a blank profile and overwrite their real one on save.
6. **Saving.** Data is saved on leave, every 60 seconds, and in `BindToClose`. For large purchases you could also trigger a save right after, so a server crash doesn't roll the purchase back. Throttle it, because DataStore calls are rate-limited.
7. **Display via Attributes.** Attributes replicate server to client only, so the UI is live and read-only. A client that edits its own copy changes nothing the server uses.

## Things to do in your own game

- Route every damage path through `Enemies.RecordDamage`, and set `EnemyType` on server-spawned enemies. Prevent farming exploits such as one-hit kills on far-away enemies, using your own combat validation.
- If you add Robux purchases, use `MarketplaceService.ProcessReceipt`. It must be idempotent: record the `PurchaseId` in the profile before granting.
- Turn on Studio API access to test DataStores, and handle `BindToClose` timing in a real server because Studio shuts down faster.
- For something more battle-tested, consider ProfileService or ProfileStore. They implement the same session-locking idea with more edge cases covered, and `Currency` and `Shop` work unchanged on top of them.
